items.name: Jamailar/Weave-Office
items.title: Jamailar/Weave-Office
items.description: One app for every document. Built for AI agents. An open-source desktop office suite written in Rust: documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDF, Markdown, code and rich text, opened, edited and saved in one row of file tabs. The same binary is a command line that AI agents call directly.
